address: Unit 206-207, 2F, Nihonmachi Mall, Soi Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Behind a black timber facade marked only by a modest sign, this Wagyu specialist exudes quiet confidence. The dark, minimalist space focuses all eyes on the chef, who grills the beef with Japanese-honed precision, coaxing out its natural aroma, tenderness and depth. House-made sauces, classic or pineapple kimchi, thoughtful sides and a neat dessert complete the experience. If you're coming as a group, book the counter seats to savour the theatre of the grill....
